messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming-p95 and p99 spike detected for model redwood-large-v1 after precision-profile autocalib rollout (int8). Service-level SLOs breached in us-west1. p95 -> 420ms (baseline 90ms), p99 -> 1.6s (baseline 350ms). Auto-remediation attempted: routing fallback to compatible-variant failed for 12% of requests. Investigating.

oncall-amber: I got paged. joining. any customer reports yet? :eyes:

ryan: I'm on it, looking at rollout logs. I see a precision-profile push at 5861234400 that switched a chunk of traffic to int8-calib/optimize-2026-03. The rollout used gradual ramp but it looks like KV cache miss amplification for streaming.

maria: Confirming telemetry: streaming stalls correlate with longer key-value cache lookups and occasional dequant deconv timeouts. CPU on tail workers not high, GPU stalls and small spikes in memory copy times.

infra-sre: Not seeing nodes OOM, but NVLink errors on a few boxes in us-west1-g. Possibly lower numeric stability with int8 path causing kernel retries -> added latency.

eng-runtime: Reproduced locally with the int8 calibration artifact: when sequence length > 1k and heavy prefix caching, we see dequant path enter fallback slow-paths. Need to revert precision profile.

oncall-amber: Actions: 1) pause rollout 2) route streaming traffic to fp16-compat variant for safety 3) notify CS for impacted customers 4) engage infra for node checks. Anyone can run roll back?

ryan: I'll pause the rollout now. running: ```./deployctl rollout pause --id int8-calib/optimize-2026-03 --region us-west1```

deploy-bot: rollout pause accepted. Canary batch stopped.

ryan: Routing update ready: adding temporary policy to prefer model_variant=fp16-compat for streaming routes in us-west1. Command: ```./routerctl update-policy --selector streaming=true --prefer-variant fp16-compat --ttl 600```

eng-runtime: Applying routing change. Should take ~30s for edge propagation.

incident-bot: Notify: routing policy change applied. Edge propagation estimated 45s.

maria: Telemetry: after pause + routing change p95 dropped to 140ms and p99 to 480ms within two rolling windows. Still above baseline for some tails but trending down.

infra-sre: I kicked nodes with NVLink errors into recycle pool and forced driver restart on 3 hosts. Watching for kernel retry errors.

cs-alerts: CS team: started identifying customers with streaming usage spike windows [5861234300-5861234700]. We have three premium customers with >99% streaming latency anomalies. Drafting a proactive message.

oncall-amber: Good. Next: revert the int8 profile from active to last-known-good (fp16 baseline) in config store and pin. Ryan, can you apply config pin?

ryan: Executing: ```./configctl set precision.profile.redwood-large-v1 active=fp16-baseline --reason "rollback after int8 calibration fallout" --ticket INC5861234567```

deploy-bot: configuration update applied to control plane. Note: some edge caches may still reference int8 until full TTL expiry.

eng-runtime: Also enabling aggressive KV prefix caching to reduce repeated lookups while we validate. Patch applied to runtime: ```PATCH: enable_kv_prefix_cache=true; cache_ttl=120s```

maria: Observability note: enabling prefix cache reduces repeated dequant paths. p95 now 95ms, p99 230ms. Still seeing intermittent streaming stalls when sequences cross chunk boundaries.

infra-sre: Looking at GPU kernel logs now. Found repeated `cuMemcpyAsync` spikes aligned with the earlier faulty hosts. Those hosts are flagged for hardware postmortem. Removing them from rotation reduced tail spikes.

cs-alerts: Customer message draft: "We've detected elevated streaming latency affecting some sessions in us-west1. We've paused a precision-profile rollout and routed traffic to fallback variants. Engineers are investigating and we've implemented mitigations. We'll follow up with incident details and next steps." Want to send now?

oncall-amber: Send to the three premium customers only for now. Do not send broad status page yet. Include ETA: 2h for root cause analysis.

cs-alerts: Sent targeted notices. Two replies already asking for timeline on SLA credits. Escalating to support lead.

eng-runtime: For long-term: we should add calibration canary tests that exercise long streaming contexts and mixed-length KV cache patterns, and add a quick rollback hook to routing layer when p99 streaming > 500ms for >2 windows.

ryan: Opening follow-up items: - INC-5861234567: rollback int8 rollout and pin fp16 (done) - RTF-9271: lifecycle for precision canary tests - RTF-9272: routing automatic fallback threshold for p99 streaming - RTF-9273: hardware flake audit for NVLink spikes

incident-bot: Incident severity escalated to Sev2 (customer-impacting) and paged infra and eng-runtime.

maria: Quick diagnostic: stacktrace fragment from runtime when stall occurs:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "runtime/quant/decoder.py", line 412, in decode_stream
    kv_cache.lookup(prefix)
  File "runtime/cache/kv.py", line 201, in lookup
    if not is_cached(prefix):
  File "runtime/quant/dequant.py", line 85, in dequantize
    result = deconv_kernel.execute(tensor)
RuntimeError: kernel retry after overflow
```

oncall-amber: That aligns with kernel retry theory. For immediate mitigation we should also reduce the max streaming chunk size for int8 paths (but we've already moved live traffic off int8). Patch ready but hold until next deploy window unless we see reappearance.

infra-sre: Hardware note: the three flagged hosts show elevated ECC corrected errors over last 7 days. Scheduling technicians for on-site check.

eng-runtime: We'll run an offline calibration validation harness that mirrors customer streaming workloads. Will report results in 2 hours.

cs-alerts: Also CC'ing account reps on the targeted customer notices. Will compile list of impacted requests/sessions for credits calculation.

oncall-amber: Current status: rollback + routing applied, node recycling in progress, prefix caching enabled. p95 ~ 100ms, p99 ~ 220ms. No new pages in 10m. Keeping Sev2 open until 2h validation window completes.

incident-bot: Reminder: create post-incident review and include precise calibration diff, kernel traces, and rollout ramp configs. Use tags: quantization, rollout, streaming-slo.

ryan: Created postmortem ticket PM-5861234567 with owners: ryan (eng-runtime), maria (observability), infra-sre. Added timeline and all commands used.

maria: Follow-ups: - instrument deconv kernel fallback counters - add e2e canary for long-context streaming - improve edge routing TTLs for faster revert - contact HW vendor about NVLink ECC pattern

cs-alerts: After targeted notices, customers acknowledged mitigation and asked for formal RCA. We'll coordinate on timing for customer-facing RCA.

oncall-amber: Thanks everyone. I'll keep watch and will escalate to Sev1 if p99 goes > 500ms again or if customer impact widens. Stand down on broad status update for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident log closed for active paging but incident remains open for postmortem until PM completion.
